ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_rank_blend_tanh_advantage
ir.intuition: Leverage advantage signals to modulate a tanh-transformed rank difference, blending margin and rank paradigms with nonlinear smoothing to capture nuanced ordered preference relations beyond simple margin losses.
ir.pseudocode:
gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
margin = tanh(alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))
rank_blend = gap * margin
loss = -mean(weight * rank_blend)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.tanh(ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)))
    rank_blend = ops.mul(gap, margin)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, rank_blend)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.mean(weighted_loss))
    return loss
